headline: Farranac Coast Post Falls into No-Man's-Land
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the only change on the boards has come at Farranac Coast, where the Colonial count has dropped from eleven to ten and one post now lies unclaimed; the most recent activity clustered around Transient Valley and The Bone Haft just before this edition closed. Elsewhere, the contested belts hold: Weathered Expanse still shows five Warden posts to four Colonial, Stlican Shelf remains five-and-four, and Stonecradle lists three Warden posts against six Colonial. Heavy casualty ledgers over the past day still lead at Stonecradle, Weathered Expanse, and Callahans Passage, with enlistments strong at the same points. Linn Mercy, Fishermans Row, and Gutter saw earlier flurries in the past twenty-four hours but have quieted by the latest observation. War 140 remains undecided, and neither faction can yet claim the thirty-four victory towns needed to close the campaign.
